method: Read all 197 Stage02/03 source, Stage04 compilation and prompt-system propositions, all 32 complete context profiles and five exact governor sets against base572–759 plus exact transitive contexts. Every full original payload and all1762 ordered bindings are verified against immutable evidence and pinned source bytes. Distinguish six explicit responsibility-division actor assignments and two manifest-field presence duties from actual current input-union, inspected-material and valid-disposition completeness. Every one of eight corrections retains exact individual predicates and occurrence sets. Archived input/output custody is checked losslessly in bounded memory/staging; no implementation, tests or proof results were consulted.

decisions.PRESERVED_SOURCES_AND_TAXONOMY: Independent external source inventory, no automatic supplied-artifact authority, legitimate inspected authorities, evidence-supported bounded no-source possibility and no invented source remain. Each named Stage03 extraction category and conflict/exception pass remains. C units/F2 echoes establish neither external authority nor semantic correctness; actual complete current coverage is separate.
decisions.EXACT_SOURCE_COMPILATION_PROMPT_GOVERNOR: Each caption retains its exact actor/modality, list boundary and governed original ID/range set. The Stage04 current-union and complete-prompt child duties are separately adjudicated. Inserted clauses are kept outside original occurrence sets; no adjacent standalone requirement is absorbed.
decisions.PRESERVED_BOUNDED_SEARCH_SCHEMA: The single current search contract and each exact scope/class/location/query/cutoff/exclusion/access/performer/capability/evidence/risk/rationale field remain. Known-authority/jurisdiction/checklist input kinds, closed generic classes, advisory count, explicit narrowing/omission reasons, independent challenge, candidate dispositions, risk and every stopping criterion remain. No accounting or input echo authorizes an unbounded or fabricated search.
decisions.PRESERVED_CHALLENGE_INDEPENDENCE: Every qualitative broad-exclusion/conflict/uncertainty/operator trigger, blind-before-first-extraction disclosure boundary, distinct reconciliation and material-disagreement blocker remains. F2 support does not establish independent extraction or review; C counts do not establish semantic completeness. Exact unit-dependent trigger populations and uncovered content are separately changed.
decisions.PRESERVED_SOURCE_AUTHENTICITY: Every distinct byte/publisher/retrieval/authenticity/authority/freshness field and each explicit local-hash limitation remains. Unknown/expired authenticity and freshness follow the applicable proof obligation and are never silently promoted. C source hashes and F2 echoes supply neither publisher authentication nor legal authority/completeness/correctness.
decisions.PRESERVED_NO_RESUPPLY: Every Stage04 prohibition on repeated request, retyping, attachment for rediscovery, manual input union, IDs and coverage remains; the project cannot be rediscovered from scratch. Actual complete current union is separately changed. A/C do not assign protocol or application mechanics to the human.
decisions.PRESERVED_MANIFEST_IDENTITY_AND_ORIGIN: The durable application-owned manifest-before-prompt order, exact stable identity/origin/source/current-version/provenance/scope fields and fixed Stage01-human/Stage03-external lineage remain. C unit binding is distinct from canonical obligation identity and whole-record hash. Presence requirements do not certify current field values or complete inspected content.
decisions.PRESERVED_SEMANTIC_MAPPING: Every allowed disposition, no disappearing obligation, one-to-many atomization, equivalent-only many-to-one without lost meaning, and independent original-ID trace remains. C occurrence non-deduplication does not forbid a separately justified semantic merge retaining all originals. Each exact application-mechanics and agent-semantic responsibility remains assigned to its original actor; actual current completeness is separately reviewed.
decisions.PRESERVED_STAGE04_CHALLENGE: Every challenge of inapplicability, potentially normative context, mandatory reduction, merge, unresolved independent truth or material uncertainty remains, with distinct reservations/contexts, no self-approval and distinct reconciliation or BLOCKED. Optional requests or supported input bases waive neither semantic truth nor independence.
decisions.PRESERVED_PROMPT_IDENTITY_AND_BOUNDARIES: Exact job/stage/operation, value/identity preservation, truthful inaccessible state/file/capability disclosure, conversation/final-JSON distinction, no later-stage work/omission/repeated available information/unsupported assumptions, ASCII quotes and identical exported/previewed/stored/hashed/receipt-linked body remain. No wrapper gains prompt authority. Current semantic content is separately changed.
decisions.PRESERVED_PROMPT_LIMITS: No silent truncation, exact file/manifest transport and nonmandatory clipboard remain. Preserve exactly 65536 bytes per member and262144 aggregate bytes, centralized/versioned/acceptance-tested controls and no increase without new profile. C1 intake safety ceilings do not change prompt thresholds; actual required context membership is separate.
decisions.CURRENT_SOURCE_RESEARCH_COVERAGE: Actual current source research completeness consumes the accepted current source set, applicable A response validity, C/C1 unit/coverage accounting through the referenced challenge contract and F2 external input basis. Preserve conflict/exception passes, semantic review and independent authenticity. Exact counts and echoes alone do not prove complete source interpretation.
decisions.CURRENT_INITIAL_SEARCH_INPUTS: Actual search-universe derivation from current Stage01 objective and every supplied reference consumes C/C1 retained distinct material/metadata/child occurrences and applicable A valid current human input. No reference disappears through equal hashes or coarse files. Closed source classes, declared scope and no-invented-source boundaries remain.
decisions.CURRENT_SEARCH_EXECUTION_AND_REVIEW_BASI: Current executed-search and accepted adequacy-review prerequisites consume applicable A current response validity and F2 external input basis. This minimum does not itself prove search execution, adequacy, authority or reviewer independence. Existing actual observations, independent review and stronger required bases remain.
decisions.CURRENT_OMISSION_UNIT_TRIGGER_AND_CLOSUR: The referenced large/complex-source, uncovered-unit and no-finding-section triggers and missing/unexamined coverage conditions consume C/C1 exact additive occurrence accounting and authorized mappings. Strict greater-than500 and every qualitative trigger remain. Unsupported/inaccessible nodes and unknown remainders cannot become favorable zero or disappear.
decisions.CURRENT_STAGE04_INPUT_UNION: Actual complete current Stage04 union consumes current human input, complete accepted Stage01 material/obligation provenance and accepted Stage03 source research under applicable A/C/C1/F2. Each named source, prohibition, evidence and unresolved obligation remains independently included. No current contents inherit completeness from older accepted identities.
decisions.CURRENT_OBLIGATION_SOURCE_LOCATOR_AND_HA: C/C1 supplies exact raw-unit provenance where used, but the base obligation-manifest source-location/value-hash fields are presence requirements and do not themselves adopt unit hash preimages. Those two proposals are independently corrected as retained; actual inspected material and union completeness remain changed.
decisions.CURRENT_INSPECTED_MATERIAL_ORIGIN: Material-origin obligation provenance consumes current C/C1 complete per-unit recorded inspection support and exact artifact bytes, with F2 applicable input support. Echoes are not semantic inspection or source authority; unavailable or blocked child content cannot be treated as inspected.
decisions.CURRENT_STAGE04_COMPLETENESS_DERIVATION: Actual rejection unless every current manifest obligation has valid disposition consumes the complete current A/C/C1/F2-governed input universe. Source §9.5 actor assignments are separately retained; changed input semantics do not move these responsibilities or prescribe new generic hash/identity algorithms. Every original trace remains.
decisions.CURRENT_PROMPT_PURPOSE_CONSTRAINTS_AND_C: Actual complete prompt purpose, do/not-do rules, required context, response contract, evidence/fail-closed/retry details and completion checklist consume applicable A–F2 semantics for the exact stage/operation. Preserve no future-stage work, no indiscriminate history dump and sole prompt authority. Retry cannot reset cumulative C1 ceilings or current F1/F2 identities/bases.
decisions.CURRENT_PROMPT_ARTIFACT_DOMAIN: Actual required material includes C/C1 retained originals/distinct verified children, applicable A/B/E current human/proof/test context and F1 exact fixture/history/target under F2. Required content is neither omitted nor truncated, and prohibited disclosure/unrelated history remains excluded. Echoes prove no external possession.
decisions.CURRENT_PROMPT_AUTHORITY_RULE_DETAIL: Actual authority instructions include A context-only affected references and request/answer ownership, B application-resolved proof relationships, E test-bound normalized snapshots and F1 bounded receipt-only conditional operation authority. Original owning stages/writers remain; a reference grants no reverse write authority and a route label grants no availability.
decisions.CORRECTION_590: Base659–667 is the obligation-manifest field list: this atom requires every obligation to receive source location (line663). It does not specify the C raw-unit locator or source-value hash algorithm as the obligation field algorithm. C successor442 expressly distinguishes accounting hashes/locators from canonical record identities; raw-unit source-value, obligation-value and complete-record bindings cannot be silently equated. Preserve this exact field-presence obligation and original occurrences. Actual current material provenance at base670 and complete union remain separately changed.

qualifier: The separately accepted technical-reference interpretation resolves policy meaning in its exact attributed scope. These historical reference qualifiers are preserved pending explicit per-entry effective-dependency and typed-governor linkage review; they are not a claim that the normative input remains missing or an automatic scope-wide identity change.
